final: WITH p AS (SELECT P.ID AS ID, P.SEX AS SEX, AVG(L.ALB) AS alb, AVG(L.UN * 1.0 / NULLIF(L."T-BIL", 0)) AS ratio FROM Laboratory L JOIN Patient P ON P.ID = L.ID WHERE P.SEX IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(P.SEX) <> '' GROUP BY P.ID, P.SEX), s AS (SELECT SEX, AVG(alb) AS avg_alb, AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM p GROUP BY SEX) SELECT SEX, avg_alb, avg_ratio, avg_alb - (SELECT AVG(avg_alb) FROM s) AS alb_above_mean FROM s WHERE avg_alb > (SELECT AVG(avg_alb) FROM s)
